title: Hotel Revenue Cockpit, models
description: Every model behind the dashboard: purpose, features, current metrics, learning curves of the last training run, feature importance, realised quality and drift of the live cancellation model. Plus the synthetic stream behind the cockpit: its events and generation runs.

panels.title: Catalog, Cancellation model
panels.description: Purpose, features and current metrics of the model as the API reports them.

panels.title: Learning curve, log loss
panels.description: Loss per boosting iteration on the training rows and on the held out validation bookings of the champion's last training run.

panels.title: Learning curve, ROC AUC
panels.description: ROC AUC per boosting iteration on the training rows and on the held out validation bookings.

panels.title: Feature importance, share of gain
panels.description: Gain of every feature in the champion booster divided by the total gain, sorted.

panels.title: Realised quality, ROC AUC per 4 week window
panels.description: Bookings scored when created, evaluated once their arrival date passed, rolling four week arrival windows.

panels.title: Realised quality, Brier against the base rate
panels.description: Brier score of the live predictions against the Brier score of predicting the base rate.

panels.title: Feature drift, PSI against the same window last year
panels.description: Population stability index of the last 30 days of new bookings against the same window one year earlier. Above 0.1 warn, above 0.25 alert.

panels.title: Drift history, max PSI per day
panels.description: Largest PSI and number of flagged features per drift run.

panels.title: Model versions
panels.description: Every trained version with its offline metrics and the champion flag.

panels.title: Retrain log
panels.description: Weekly challenger against champion on the last 60 days of arrivals.

panels.title: Calibration, predicted against observed cancel rate per decile
panels.description: Offline deciles on the books at the snapshot from the training run, live deciles from booking time scores of arrivals in the last eight weeks. Gap is observed minus predicted.

panels.title: Experiments on the stream, validation and test metrics per setup
panels.description: Every setup of the experiments notebook: window, outlier treatment, scaling, feature selection, hyperparameter search, class weights, model families and calibration. Sorted by validation ROC AUC.

panels.title: Catalog, Demand forecast
panels.description: Purpose, features and current metrics of the model as the API reports them.

panels.title: Learning curve, City Hotel
panels.description: Per backtest origin: in sample MAPE of the chosen method over the last 52 weeks of the training window (train) against the MAPE of its 8 week forecast from that origin (test), with the seasonal naive forecast from the same origin as reference (dashed). The test line is one forecast of eight weeks, so it moves with the season: percentage errors are larger in the low season weeks and after demand shocks that the rooms on the books do not show yet.

panels.title: Learning curve, Resort Hotel
panels.description: Per backtest origin: in sample MAPE of the chosen method over the last 52 weeks of the training window (train) against the MAPE of its 8 week forecast from that origin (test), with the seasonal naive forecast from the same origin as reference (dashed). The test line is one forecast of eight weeks, so it moves with the season: percentage errors are larger in the low season weeks and after demand shocks that the rooms on the books do not show yet.

panels.title: Stream batches
panels.description: Every batch of the synthetic stream: the full history build and the daily batches with the booking dates they cover, the bookings emitted, the bookings kept frozen and the open outcomes flipped by the daily hazard (events, storms, no shows). A batch older than two days raises the stream stale alert.
